BRANDING & GRAPHIC DESIGN

Give your business a visual
identity people can recognise.

I create visual systems and everyday design assets that help your business communicate consistently across its website, presentations, and marketing.

Possible deliverables

  • Visual direction and references
  • Logo development or refinement
  • Colour and typography system
  • Brand usage guidelines
  • Social and campaign templates
  • Presentation and marketing assets
  • Agreed editable source files and export formats

From direction to usable assets

Understand the business → agree direction → develop concepts → refine the selected direction → prepare final assets and guidance.

A scope built around your assets

Design projects are quoted around the assets and revision rounds you need. Ongoing design support can be scoped separately.

Design questions

Can you work with my existing brand?+

Yes. A project can extend your current identity or develop a new direction, depending on the brief.

What files will I receive?+

The proposal lists the editable files, export formats, usage guidance, and ownership terms included.

How do revisions work?+

Your proposal sets the review stages and revision rounds. Additional requests are assessed for cost and schedule impact before work proceeds.
